# REMAINING WORK

> The Awtsmoos creates each next step where yesterday had none; we do not call the vessel finished while a truthful task is undone.  
> Awtsmoos.com receives the many streams, yet proof must close each gate; this ledger stays alive until the work itself says complete.

## Open — Architecture and Collision Safety

- [ ] Refresh collision scan for `core/movie`, `awtsmoos-ui`, and `awtsmoos-studio` immediately before source writes.
- [ ] Inspect core package/module conventions and proven reusable procedural asset exports.
- [ ] Inspect clean integration seams for Animator, Nesher, Mitzvah, Video Editor, and Slides.

## Open — Canonical Movie Core

- [ ] Write small canonical domain modules.
- [ ] Write deterministic evaluator/interpolation modules.
- [ ] Write feature catalog, capability planner, validation, and coverage modules.
- [ ] Write procedural movie asset intent/catalog facade over existing core assets.
- [ ] Write AI intent compiler.
- [ ] Write local movie export index.

## Open — Awtsmoos UI

- [ ] Write safe JSON node grammar.
- [ ] Write bindings/action resolution.
- [ ] Write DOM compiler.
- [ ] Write mobile-first tokens.
- [ ] Write reusable studio shell recipe.
- [ ] Write package exports.

## Open — Awtsmoos Studio

- [ ] Write app state/controller/playback modules.
- [ ] Write Canvas render dispatch and semantic renderers.
- [ ] Write explicit hybrid capability profile.
- [ ] Write shared-UI recipe and mobile CSS.
- [ ] Write exact 180-second proof movie fixture.
- [ ] Write bootstrap HTML/main module.

## Open — Legacy Studio Unification

- [ ] Animator adapter/profile.
- [ ] Nesher adapter/profile.
- [ ] Mitzvah adapter/profile.
- [ ] Video Editor adapter/profile.
- [ ] Slides adapter/profile.
- [ ] Wire safe entrypoints or document collision-bound seams with tested import adapters.

## Open — Real Media Proof

- [ ] Discover local ffmpeg/ffprobe and existing renderer/export CLI/browser capture paths.
- [ ] Produce real 180-second media from canonical proof movie if available tooling allows deterministic export.
- [ ] Verify container duration and inspect produced artifact.

## Open — Tests and Runtime Verification

- [ ] Syntax-check all new JS.
- [ ] Run movie-core unit/integration tests.
- [ ] Run Awtsmoos UI tests.
- [ ] Run three-minute fixture coverage tests.
- [ ] Import-smoke legacy adapters.
- [ ] Audit code line counts <=120 where required.
- [ ] Audit tabs/no minified functions and required source headers/JSDoc.
- [ ] Start app server and run browser smoke.
- [ ] Verify desktop UI.
- [ ] Verify mobile UI.
- [ ] Verify play/pause/scrub/scene switching/AI intent loading.
- [ ] Inspect console errors.
- [ ] Inspect/export media when produced.

## Open — Completion Shadow Work

- [ ] Re-read every file written in this mission.
- [ ] Compare final implementation against all three planning phases.
- [ ] Record missing/deferred work and resolve every safe item.
- [ ] Write implementation delta report.
- [ ] Write verification evidence report.
- [ ] Write final handoff with honest limitations and exact file paths.

## NEXT_ACTION

Refresh the collision scan and read the exact core package/module conventions before source writes.
